note: Overrides for Wikidata values this project has checked and found wrong. Each one records what Wikidata said, what it should say, and how that was established, so a reader can disagree with the correction rather than having to trust it. refresh-nobel.ts warns when `wasSaying` no longer matches -- that means Wikidata has changed and the override may no longer be needed.

Q157255.name: Merton Miller
Q157255.why: The English label on this item had been changed to the name of an American actor. Everything else on the item is the economist: born 1923-05-16, died 2000-06-03, Nobel Memorial Prize in economics 1990, and the French, German and Chinese labels read 'Merton Miller', 'Merton H. Miller' and '默顿·米勒'. The English description still read 'American economist (1923-2000)'. The label was the only field affected, which is what vandalism to a Wikidata item usually looks like.
